This significant effect of Al12(Fe,V)3Si precipitates on the yield strength is due to their nanoscale size (<50 nm). Moreover, increasing the volume percentage of precipitates in the alloys leads to a decrease in the mean distance between them, which makes dislocation movement more difficult. It consequently increases the strength and reduces the ductility.
